 Prayer :- Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of I
 praying for issuance of Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, to call fo
 entire records relating to the impugned proceedings in vide under
 Na.Ka.No.744/A3/2024 dated 28.02.2024 issued by the second
 respondent and quash the same as illegal and consequently permit th
 writ petitioner to run petty shop namely M/s.Thangvel Malikai Shop
 situated at No.37, Indira Nagar, Ilayankudi Salai East, Sivagangai
 District by unsealing the premises. 
 For Petitioner : Mr.A.Mathan
 For R1 to R3 : Mr.G.V.Vairam Santhosh
 Additional Government Ple
 For R4 : Mr.M.Vaikkam Karunanidhi
 Government Advocate
 Order
The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition and he also made an endorsement to that effect. 
__ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.In view of the same , this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. 
No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
